Form-VIII
CERTIFICATE FROM OVERSEAS PAKISTANIS FOR ADMISSION OF THEIR CHILDREN / WARDS ON
RESERVED SEATS UNDER CATEGORY S & SI
(PLEASE FILL IN BLOCK LETTERS ONLY)
The University of Engineering & Technology, Lahore has reserved one hundred and sixty eight (168) seats in
its Bachelor’s Degree Programs for the Children / Wards of Pakistanis working in foreign countries. To ensure that these
seats go to the rightful claimants, the parent (father / mother / guardian) of the applicant is required to get this
certificate signed from the Pakistani Embassy in the country in which he/she is working. The sponsor should
also get the photocopies of his/her passport and resident visa/residence permit attested by the same Embassy.
University of Engineering and Technology (UET) Lahore, Pakistan will be obliged to the respective Pakistani embassies
for their co-operation in providing the following information.
Embassy of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan of (Country)

Embassy of Pakistan
(Oﬃcial Embossed Seal)
IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS
Definition of a Guardian For Applicants who are Orphans :
(i) Real brother; (ii) Real maternal uncle (Mamoo) (iii) Real paternal uncle (Chacha, Taya)
In case of an orphan following additional documents are required: (1) Father’s death certificate issued by NADRA; (2 ) Proof of relationship with
the guardian in the form of CNIC of all family members and NADRA Family Registration Certificate (FRC) highlighting the Family Tree structure
of the applicant; (3) Copy of Nikahnama in case the guardian is the maternal uncle (Mamoo) of the applicant.
Incomplete Form/Form without documents shall not be acceptable in any circumstances.
WARNING
Fake / tempered documents shall be rejected and such students will be black listed and they will not be eligible for admission in any
university of Pakistan.
Overseas Sponsor’s
Photograph
Attested by
Concerned Embassy
